salary_details.details: The appointee shall not be entitled to any benefit like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion etc., or any other benefits available to Government servants, appointed on regular basis. selection_process: The selection process consists of an online interview.
Tentative dates and time of online interview through Google meet are from 29.10.2026 and 30.10.2026 (Time 10:00 A.M to 6:00 P.M).
how_to_apply: Download the prescribed format available on the DHS website https://dhs.andamannicobar.gov.in.
Fill out the application form in block letters with required personal and educational details.
Affix a recent passport size photo on the application form.
Gather self-attested copies of all required documents along with the completed application.
Submit the complete application and supporting documents via email to [email protected] before 22 October 2026 at 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: The appointment is purely on contract basis for a period of one year or till the regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier. The appointment can also be terminated at any time, by giving one month's notice or by paying one month's salary. The appointee shall not be granted any claim or right for regular appointment to any post under Central Health Service. The Selection Committee has the right to accept / reject any application without assigning any reason thereof. Original documents of the selected candidates will be physically verified upon reporting for duty. Contact Number for queries: 03192 - 233331.

faq.question: Q1. What is DHS Andaman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a contractual recruitment notification released by the Directorate of Health Services Andaman & Nicobar to fill 22 Specialist and Medical posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under DHS Andaman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 22 vacancies are available across various specialist and medical posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DHS Andaman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of application through online email is 22 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for DHS Andaman posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess the essential qualification as per MCI prevailing norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for DHS Andaman recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 65 years for all posts.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for DHS Andaman posts?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for DHS Andaman recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their filled applications in the prescribed format along with self-attested documents via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for DHS Andaman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection is based on an online interview conducted via Google Meet.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for DHS Andaman posts?
faq.answer: The remuneration ranges from Rs. 2.5 lacs to Rs. 3.00 lacs per month depending on the post and posting location.

faq.question: Q10. When will the online interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The tentative dates for the online interview are 29.10.2026 and 30.10.2026 from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
